MINI MINUTES:

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-24-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Denise Doucette.
Michael T. Sweeney, Esq. for Petitioner: Tracey I. Sinclair, present as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Ashley Elaine Reagan, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Ashley Elaine Sinclair.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-20-2007 Reset To Apr-24-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: F. Butler.
Michael Sweeney, Esq. for Petitioner: Ashley Elaine Reagan, not present.
Matter is continued to Apr. 24, 2007 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for appearance of the Petitioner.
Notice of new hearing date to the Minor's father by mail is acceptable by the Court.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the minor were made at the hearing.
